name: seenby
description: AI search visibility tracking: see how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI answers mention your brand with Seenby.

interface.shortDescription: Track brand mentions in AI answers
interface.longDescription: AI search visibility tracking for your brand. Read your Seenby reports for AI visibility tracking, LLM brand monitoring and generative engine optimization (GEO): the questions where ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews leave your brand out or rank it behind a rival, who they name instead, and the pages those answers cite. Set up new brands from a website, add questions and competitors, and start runs within your plan's limits.
interface.defaultPrompt: Where is my brand missing in AI answers this week, and which pages should I get onto?
